title: Drilling through 2x6s for Ribbon Boards
reason: Describes the process of working on ribbon boards and drilling holes in 2x6 wood.

tasks.task: Describe the process of working on ribbon boards and drilling holes in 2x6 wood.

subtasks.text: Use a battery-powered drill to create initial holes but ran into power issues.
Buy sharper drill bits at Menards and get longer drill bits to finish drilling holes.
Use an electrical drill with a generator for the final drilling and cutting.
Cut 16-foot 2x6 wood in half to connect on both sides of the pole.
Plan to finish the current side and proceed to the end frames.
